keyGuide.heading: How to get a {{provider}} key
keyGuide.paste: Paste the key in the API key field and click Save.

openai: Sign in at platform.openai.com (your ChatGPT account works).
Go to Settings → Billing and add credit.
Open API keys and click Create new secret key.
Copy the key now. It is shown only once.
anthropic: Go to Settings → Billing and buy credits.
Open API keys and click Create key.
Copy the key now. It is shown only once.
google: Sign in at aistudio.google.com with your Google account.
Click Get API key, then Create API key.
Copy the key. It starts with AIza.
openrouter: Open Keys and click Create API key.
Copy the key now. It is shown only once.
groq: Open API Keys and click Create API Key.
Copy the key now. It is shown only once.
deepseek: Open API keys, click Create new API key and copy it.
mistral: Choose a plan (Experiment is free) and verify your phone number.
Open API Keys, click Create new key and copy it.
xai: Open API Keys, click Create API key and copy it.
together: Open Settings → API Keys and copy your key.
ollama: Install Ollama from ollama.com and open it.
Download a model in a terminal: ollama pull llama3.2
Click Save here, then pick the model under Model.
lmstudio: Install LM Studio from lmstudio.ai and download a model.
Open the Developer tab, start the server and turn on CORS.
Click Save here, then pick the model under Model.

note.openai: Paid. The API is billed separately from a ChatGPT subscription.
note.anthropic: Paid. The API is billed separately from a Claude Pro or Max plan.
note.google: Free tier with daily limits, no credit card needed. On the free tier Google may use your prompts to improve its products.
note.openrouter: One key for hundreds of models. Models ending in :free cost nothing; the others use prepaid credits.
note.groq: Free tier with rate limits. Runs open models such as Llama very fast.
note.deepseek: Paid, at a low price. The key works once your balance is above zero.
note.mistral: A new key can take a few minutes to start working.
note.xai: Paid. The key works once you have credits.
note.together: Paid. The key works once you have credit.
note.ollama: Free and private: the model runs on your computer, so nothing leaves it.
note.lmstudio: Free and private: the model runs on your computer, so nothing leaves it.
